clientId.title: DB RIS Maps Client ID
clientId.description: Deutsche Bahn RIS API client ID.

steps: Register/log in to the DB API Marketplace via 'DB Kundenkonto' and create an application.
Request access to the RIS::Maps API (ris-maps/v2), part of DB's RIS ÖPNV API family.
Once authorized, subscribe ('Abonnieren') RIS::Maps to your application.
Open the application's details and copy its Client ID into this field.
x-openmapx-setup.cost: No public self-service tier — pricing/quota set per contract.
x-openmapx-setup.notes: RIS::Maps (live vehicle positions) is not in the open self-service catalog and requires a positive authorization check and contract with Deutsche Bahn AG. Shares one DB RIS credential set with geocoding-db-ris and transit-ris-routing.

steps: Register/log in to the DB API Marketplace and create an application ('Neue Anwendung erstellen').
Copy the Client Secret (API key) shown once at application creation.
After DB authorizes access, subscribe ('Abonnieren') the RIS::Maps API to that application.
Paste the Client Secret here (sent as the DB-Api-Key header).
x-openmapx-setup.cost: No public self-service tier — pricing/quota set per contract.
x-openmapx-setup.notes: Requires Deutsche Bahn AG authorization. The same Client Secret can be reused for all three DB RIS integrations; it is shown only once at creation.

administrationIds.title: Administration IDs
administrationIds.description: Comma-separated RIS administration IDs to request. Defaults to 80,81.
